description: Does AR(1) describe the real noise? Per real case: the ACF of the Theil-Sen-detrended anomalies against r1**k, the Bartlett variance inflation (36 lags) against the AR(1) value with the same weights, and an AR(p) model (Yule-Walker, order by AIC up to 12) fitted to the residuals divided by their calendar-month SD. Trend-free records simulated from that model (times the month SD, on the case's calendar) go through trendcourt.benchmark.run_case (no seasonal test) and the verdict policy as applied (band from each replicate's own r1_detrended), as in docs/benchmark/applied.json. 'stated_fpr' is the rate of the band of the case's observed r1_detrended. 'ar_widening' is sqrt of the AR(p) long-run variance ratio, the widening the fitted model calls for; 'ar1_widening' the factor the rule applies.
